title: A Metric Mix-Up Left A Plane 24,600 Pounds Short
hook: A metric mix-up left a plane 24,600 pounds short.
closing: Shared units seem boring until a mismatch puts a mission or lives at risk.
question: Should everyone use metric?

segments.say: Only 5% of the world's population lives in the non-metric countries shown, making them the exception.
The actual altitude was 57 kilometers, showing how a unit mismatch can erase a safe margin.
The fuel load was 24,600 pounds short, turning a conversion mistake into a physical emergency.
